text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Authentication also matters, as it ensures that only the right people can access accounts or systems. Another important practice is input validation, which checks the data users submit and helps block harmful code. Developers should also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, so they can prevent them. By following these practices, developers can build safer websites and protect users from online threats.
